name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport started young, fueled by watching Ayrton Senna dominate the tracks. He honed his skills through vocational training in São Paulo, specializing in metal fabrication and welding. He quickly gained a reputation for his precision and ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues. His dedication landed him a spot with Eurofarma RC, where he's been instrumental in maintaining and improving their race cars.

Rafael's approach to fabrication is meticulous. He believes in getting the details right, understanding that even the smallest imperfection can affect performance. He's known for his innovative solutions to common problems, often devising clever modifications to enhance reliability and efficiency. While focused on his work, he's also a strong team player, always willing to lend a hand and share his knowledge.

Rafael is distinguished by his ability to blend traditional fabrication techniques with modern technology. He's always eager to learn new skills and embrace innovative approaches. His ambition drives him to push the boundaries of what's possible, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed sides with slightly longer hair on top, often styled with gel.
physical.description: Rafael is of medium build with a focused gaze and calloused hands that speak to his craft.

quirks: Always sharpens his welding rods to an almost dangerous point.
Listens to Brazilian samba music through headphones while working, but only at a very low volume.
Keeps a small, well-worn notebook filled with sketches and technical ideas.
